perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

flavor: Host a launch party with the Typhon GL5 by Omolon.
